label: Actual belief meeting a supplied warrant standard
definition: An actual belief in content p by agent a with Warrant a p under the supplied interpretation. Reason a p says a reason exists for a to believe p. Believes a p records uptake of the attitude. Eligible a p supplies the separate basing, sufficiency and undefeatedness conditions used by the warrant bridge.
note: Analyst profile. Warrant is a supplied epistemic predicate and can allow justified error. No logic or benchmark score warrants an actual belief without an independently calibrated bridge.
